prompt: Create a high-fidelity desktop web dashboard comp for MabarQueue, a streamer tool for managing a live Mobile Legends VIP mabar queue with synthetic data. Make this variation current-turn-led: the main focus is a large currently-playing panel with a visible next-up queue below, a compact left navigation, a session header, and a bottom action bar for marking match selesai, melewati, and adding a player. Show Indonesian labels, player names, ready and offline states, donation source labels, positions, and matches remaining. Include the named action Tambah Pemain and a recent donation feed. Use the Fillmore handbill direction as a restrained world through warm cream ground, saturated red and mustard ink, deep navy contrast, expressive display typography, bold flat surfaces, and one continuous printed-sheet treatment linking the current player to the queue. Keep standard web components, readable realistic text, strong hierarchy, high contrast, and a practical operating feel. Edge-to-edge screen with no browser frame or device. The result must clearly read as a streamer dashboard, never a poster or abstract artwork.
